title: Model marketplace + pricing snapshot kit for next release notes
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a comprehensive screenshot asset kit and accompanying visuals for the March release notes and onboarding quickstart. These assets will be used in: 1) Release notes (new models + deprecations), 2) Quickstart docs, 3) Marketing / in-product banners.

Deliverables:
- High-fidelity model catalog screenshots (light + dark) showing: model cards, performance badges, and 'Add to project' CTA. Two widths: doc inline (1200x700) and hero (1600x900).
- Pricing table screenshots that reflect new tier rows and deprecation footnote. Desktop and mobile breakpoints. Include currency localization variants for USD and EUR.
- Focused callouts: "New: LlamaX-13B (quantized)" and "Deprecated: Llama-7S (legacy)" badges. Separate transparent PNG badges for editorial use.
- Accessibility: alt-text file for every screenshot and a 4.5:1 contrast audit note.
- Figma file with organized frames and export slices, plus a Drive folder with final PNGs (1x, 2x).

Technical specifications / constraints:
- Use our product UI token set (Figma library: Redwood UI Tokens).
- Ensure kerning and tokenized price strings are editable for translation.
- For pricing table, show per-token estimate, reserved capacity note, and a deprecation tooltip mock.
- Include an "effective date" overlay for deprecations with our standard orange alert style.

Acceptance criteria:
- All screenshots approved by PM & Eng for content accuracy (model names, specs, pricing).
- Two color-mode variants exported and verified at 1x and 2x.
- Figma file contains named export slices and a README frame with export steps.
- PRD links and API names added to alt-text for engineers to validate copy.

Handoff notes:
- Upload final assets to Drive:/Releases/2026-03-Model-Pricing-Screens.
- Add images to docs repo PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs#PR-XXXX.
- Callout to marketing for one hero banner and one email-responsive variant.
